title: Invoice Number Check
description: Keeps GST invoice numbers legal under CGST Rule 46(b) by counting to 16, naming the character that isn't a letter, digit, - or /, catching a number already used this financial year even in different capitals (as GST portals compare them), a stale year token, a skipped or reused counter and gaps in the series, and offering the next number with a fresh series from 1 April.
